in_marathi.name: Rushi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Wise, learned, intelligent
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rushi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is learned, knowledgeable, and wise. A sage, a scholar, a seer. A name for a child who is destined to grow up to be a wise and intelligent individual.

in_bengali.name: Rushi
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Wise, learned, intelligent
in_bengali.long_meaning: Rushi একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who is learned, knowledgeable, and wise. A sage, a scholar, a seer. A name for a child who is destined to grow up to be a wise and intelligent individual.
